info.title: Oversight API
info.description:
Watch Microsoft Foundry agents through their Application Insights telemetry, read runs step by step, ask a judge model for intent, and publish eval cases to Foundry.

Auth: none. The API is single-user, listens on 127.0.0.1, and calls Azure as whoever ran `az login`.

get.summary: Health of the Azure CLI session, Foundry and the telemetry poller

get.description: text/event-stream. Event types: status, overview, activity, insight, intent, alert, settings, evals, evals.uploaded, heartbeat. Each data line is JSON `{type, agent?, conversationId?, data}`.

parameters.name: conversation
parameters.description: Only events for this conversation id.

Upload approved cases to Foundry: dataset version + eval + run
post.description: Writes to the Foundry project: a new version of dataset `oversight-<agent>-evals`, the eval `oversight-<agent>` (created once), and an eval run graded on each case's logged response.

post.summary: Grade an agent's recent runs from its App Insights traces (shows under the agent in Foundry)
post.description: Creates (once) the eval `oversight-traces-<agent>` with intent resolution, task adherence and tool call accuracy graders, then starts a run with data source `azure_ai_traces` for the agent's gen_ai.agent.id. Only runs whose spans record gen_ai.input/output messages are graded.
